mcp.name: ai.com.mcp/linkedin
mcp.description: LinkedIn API as MCP tools to retrieve profile data and publish content. Powered by HAPI MCP.

profile_text.body:
LinkedIn, founded in 2003 and based in Sunnyvale, California, is a professional networking platform with 1 billion members. According to its website, the service enables users to manage their professional identity, build and engage with professional networks, and access knowledge, insights and opportunities. The platform offers features including Open To Work for job seeking, messaging, live videos, stories, and newsletters focused on industry discussions.

LinkedIn has made its API available as an MCP tool through ai.com.mcp/linkedin, powered by HAPI MCP, allowing retrieval of profile data and publishing of content. The company maintains a significant legal presence, with 220 cases tracked in California where it is headquartered.
